Addition of Forces: Vector Triangle and Components

Resultant, ΣF
—
Direction (from the +x-axis)
—
Rx = ΣFx
—
Ry = ΣFy
—
Drag the arrowheads of P (blue) and Q (green). Scale: 1 box = 5 N.
  • Vector triangle method: place the tail of Q at the tip of P. The resultant ΣF (red) joins the tail of P to the tip of Q.
  • Tick the first box to add them in the other order: you get the same resultant.
  • Measure the resultant the way you would on paper: count boxes for its length, and read its angle from the +x-axis. Untick Show the answers first, then tick it to check.
